A1.justification: Both PDFs describe USERMIRRORER and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–F. Content can be reliably matched despite pagination and layout changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original user-simulation accuracy, recommendation experiments using simulated feedback, ablations, and cross-domain evaluations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results and adds a GPT-5 comparison row to Table 1.

M1.justification: Scene construction, decision-process generation, uncertainty-based selection, rejection sampling, and SFT/DPO/GRPO procedures are unchanged. Appendix B and the prompts in Appendix E retain the same method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight recommendation domains, Amazon subsets, general-purpose training mixture, interactive recommendation scenarios, and cross-domain tests. The new digital-twin discussion introduces no evaluated domain.

E2.justification: v3 adds GPT-5 (2025-08-07) to the main comparison in Table 1 without removing existing comparators. GPT-5 already participated in Figure 2 and Appendix Table 14 in v2, but was absent from its Table 1.

E3.justification: Training and evaluation sample counts, exposure lengths, inference settings, recommendation-data splits, and training configurations remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendices A–C. The added GPT-5 row introduces no separately documented protocol change.

E4.justification: Training-size sensitivity, data-selection comparisons, decision-factor analyses, feature ablations, confidence and reasoning-style analyses, cross-domain transfer, and case studies are retained unchanged, including Appendices D and F.

E5.justification: Both versions average five generated outputs per evaluation scene, report standard deviations in Table 2, and retain the same plus/minus reporting in Table 12. No run-count, seed, or statistical-estimation changes are documented.

E6.justification: The added GPT-5 row in Table 1 reports Amazon accuracy of 40.2% and overall accuracy of 42.2%. Its other domain values match GPT-5 results already in Table 14. Existing Table 1 rows, Tables 2–14, and plotted results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Definitions 2.1 and 3.1, Equations 1–3, and their mathematical explanations remain unchanged. The digital-twin discussion adds conceptual analogies without new formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The central claims remain feedback-based data distillation, improved preference alignment of lightweight simulators, interpretable decision processes, and useful recommendation feedback. v3 presents digital-twin applications as prospective extensions.

C2.justification: The expanded conclusion interprets the framework through cognitive digital twins, drawing parallels with battery health modeling, knowledge transfer, and uncertainty-aware decisions under noisy observations. Existing result interpretations and limitations concerning multimodality and non-interaction feedback are unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 changes the code repository pointer and adds explicit links to the constructed dataset and DPO model checkpoint. Hardware, hyperparameters, software tools, processing instructions, and prompt templates remain unchanged; the PDFs alone do not verify linked resource availability.

R1.justification: The introduction and conclusion add cognitive digital-twin positioning and supporting literature on manufacturing, battery health, and uncertainty-aware decisions, plus recent recommendation and reasoning works. DeepSeek-R1 and DPO reference updates concern existing works.

P1.justification: v3 expands introductory context and the conclusion, adds acknowledgments, converts several inline enumerations into bullets, and corrects Appendix A.2's dataset-statistics reference from Table 7 to Table 6. The main section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4 is enlarged from single-column placement to placement across both columns. Table 1 gains a row and larger sizing, while other displays and text reflow. Existing figure content is retained without redrawing or new plots.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves usability through a more legible Figure 4, explicit dataset/checkpoint access pointers, a fuller main comparison table, and the corrected dataset-statistics cross-reference. The method and nearly all empirical evidence remain unchanged. The broader digital-twin discussion is prospective and supplies no additional validation, so the overall gains are limited.
